sources.title: How to design a UI button for Video Games
sources.creator: Sprung Studios
sources.observed: The studio describes a moodboard→variants→feedback→polish process. It resolves setting, color, texture, silhouette and type before detailed rendering. Its restart example builds a 2D industrial surface with coherent light, bolts and reflection; final art was inspected against a concrete backdrop. It plans localization and interaction-state mockups before finishing. The studio explicitly calls the result a training exercise, not a client-ready deliverable.
sources.limit: No numerical geometry prescription; No usability outcome or causal improvement; No production-state behavior or animation verified

inspection.method: Public web article plus direct original WIP and final-image inspection in own cloud browser tab

rights.included: Original paraphrase and verified links only; no source artwork, font or asset bytes bundled

sources.title: Rend
sources.creator: Sprung Studios / Frostkeep
sources.observed: The production account combines Norse/Celtic ornament with simpler rectangular interactive frames. It separates crafting and talent structures by flow direction, makes bright stats legible using strong borders, and shrinks chat during other tasks. The inspected concept retains scene context around a large dark talent panel, puts details beside the graph, and leaves compact status/action groups at the lower edges. Placeholder copy makes this a concept, not current runtime evidence.
sources.limit: No arbitrary panel-occupancy percentage; No universal ornament or HUD-corner rule; No contemporary runtime or input verified

inspection.method: Public article and complete original talent-screen concept image viewed in own cloud browser

rights.included: Original paraphrase and links only; no source image bytes bundled

sources.title: UMG Styling
sources.creator: Epic Games
sources.observed: The documentation separates widget states, per-state image/material choices, tint, margins and padding. Box rendering stretches a 3×3 image while preserving margin-defined edges; Border tiles edges with an empty center; Image ignores margins. Render transforms alter a visual relative to layout and may extend beyond parent clipping. These implementation mechanics require runtime inspection, not source-only approval.
sources.limit: Not portable API names for all engines; No motion timings prescribed; No current-engine execution performed

inspection.method: Official documentation text opened with public web tool

rights.included: Original paraphrase and official link only; no source code or images bundled

sources.title: Playables design best practices
sources.creator: Google / YouTube Playables
sources.observed: The platform guidance separates host actions, game canvas and menus. It recommends aspect-aware resizing or letterboxing, clear scaled text/assets, minimal/contextual onboarding, distinct button states and explicit pause/end messages. Its touch recommendation is 48×48 dp with 8 dp spacing, separating visible icon from touch area. Those units and values belong to this platform guidance, not a universal CSS-pixel recipe.
sources.limit: No user-testing result for this framework; No universal game HUD geometry; No evidence that dp, CSS px and engine units are interchangeable

inspection.method: Official full page text opened with public web tool

sources.title: Creating Satisfying Buttons with Flowlab 🌟 #nocode #gamedev #cozyvibes #design #cozygaming
sources.creator: flowlabIO; linked example by Samuel Tome
sources.observed: The actual Short page verifies the title, channel, date and 22-second duration; it has no added description. The creator-linked example separately shows PLAY/SHOP/EXIT as rounded thick-ink controls with bright faces, lower bodies and heavy outlined white type over a pixel scene. One later render with the pointer over PLAY shows a larger visible control; its hit region, timing and behavior graph remain unmeasured. This is an authored effect example, not evidence that every menu should use equal dominant buttons.
sources.limit: No Short frame viewed; No exact hover/press timing; No stable-hitbox assertion; No measured user benefit or real menu transition

inspection.method: Actual Shorts page and expanded watch-page date inspected in own cloud tab; player stalled. Creator-linked example rendered separately and its read-only editor label was verified.
